item.title: Genesis 5.5-Flash Released
item.description: Genesis 5.5-Flash is officially live, scaling up to over 525,000 parameters from the 45,000 parameters of the 5.0 model. This version delivers significantly greater knowledge capacity and superior performance compared to all previous models, dramatically optimizing sequence training data flow.
